build_gumbel_vector_quantizer: build a GumbelVectorQuantizer module with configurable groups, temperature decay, and vq_dim for vector quantization
run_forward_quantization: run forward pass through GumbelVectorQuantizer to quantize input tensors using gumbel softmax sampling
sample_codebook_vectors: sample random vectors from the quantizer codebook using sample_from_codebook with batch and sample size
review_codebook_indices: review the codebook indices and perplexity metrics computed by the GumbelVectorQuantizer forward pass
test_temperature_decay: test the set_num_updates method to verify temperature annealing from max to min over training steps
